summary.headline: LG Electronics India Q2 FY27 revenue rose 19.5% YoY to INR 73.8 bn, with EBITDA margin up 63 bps to 9.5%.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations grew 19.5% YoY to INR 73.8 bn, with every key category growing in high-teens to double digits. EBITDA rose 28% to INR 7.01 bn and PAT grew 25.7% to INR 4.89 bn. H1 revenue grew 17.5% to INR 146.13 bn and H1 EBITDA grew 27.9% to INR 16.16 bn. Management kept FY27 guidance of mid-teens revenue growth and early double-digit EBITDA margin, and announced entry into the vehicle solutions (VS) business.

segments.name: Home Appliances & Air Solutions
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 47.72 bn, +20.9% YoY, highest quarterly growth since listing; EBIT INR 4.16 bn, +28.4%, margin 8.7% vs 8.2%. Washing machines, refrigerators and RAC all grew double digits; dishwashers had a breakout quarter.

segments.name: Home Entertainment
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 26.08 bn, +17.2% YoY, third consecutive double-digit quarter; EBIT INR 3.37 bn, +19.9%, margin 12.9% vs 12.6%. Offline value market share at an all-time high; B2B information display is now described as a second profit engine.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance unchanged: mid-teens revenue growth and early double-digit EBITDA margin; management aims to beat guidance and industry.
Compressor commercial production at Sri City (AP) to start in Q3 FY27; RAC manufacturing there to follow around January 2027 (Q4 FY27), with both lines fully operational by end FY27.
Sri City plant: committed investment of about INR 50 bn over next few years; expected to double existing production capacity and serve domestic and export markets.
Q4 is the biggest RAC season (about 55% of annual RAC sales), and management expects the next two quarters to be better than the same period last year.
Management expects significant YoY export revenue growth in FY27.
B2B long-run ambition of 20%+ growth; B2B is about 10-12% of revenue, with a goal of meaningful growth over the next three years.
capex_capacity: Sri City (Andhra Pradesh) third plant: compressor production in Q3 FY27, RAC production around January 2027; compressor plant adds about 2 million units of capacity and reduces reliance on outsourced compressors.
Q2 capex INR 8.7 bn, progressing in line with internal targets.
Vehicle solutions (telematics and automotive electronics) to be manufactured at the Sri City plant in phases, starting with telematics.
New product categories under evaluation: chest freezers, built-in kitchen solutions; premium French door and side-by-side refrigerators recently launched.
demand_pricing: Management says demand is encouraging into Q3 and Q4; washing machines had their fastest growth in eight quarters, with fully automatic now above 60% of washing machine sales.

Side-by-side and French door refrigerators grew more than 50%; single-door refrigerators grew double digits. TV 55-inch and above now more than half of TV revenue (exact share not clearly stated), and 32-inch also picked up.
Pricing: two rounds of selective price increases taken this year, with cost pressure from steel, aluminium, copper and resin. Management says no major demand slowdown seen after increases.
Exports: markets expanded from 50 to 68 countries; distribution partners up from 112 to 151; Essential series now in 21 countries.

B2B: institutional display is the strongest-performing B2B segment, led by commercial TV; system AC growing in large commercial projects. Data-centre cooling (chillers) under watch, not yet quantified.

qa_highlights.question: How is demand trending across AC, refrigerator, washing machine and TV into H2 FY27, and has seasonality changed?
qa_highlights.answer: Management sees encouraging demand into Q3 and Q4 with all categories growing double digits in Q2. RAC Q2 sales were better than Q1 despite off-season, driven by heat; Q4 is about 55% of annual RAC sales.

qa_highlights.question: Why enter vehicle solutions, and how will it be built and grown?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited India's growing automotive electronics market and LG's global telematics leadership. The business will be built in phases starting with telematics, manufactured locally at Sri City, and is positioned as an additional growth pillar alongside appliances.

qa_highlights.question: What is driving the margin strength and why is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give margin guidance but pointed to premiumisation, a richer channel mix, and growing B2B, exports and AMC services, which earn above-average margins. Scale and localisation are expected to add to this.

qa_highlights.question: When will Sri City production start and what cost benefits are expected?
qa_highlights.answer: Compressor commercial production starts in Q3 FY27 and AC manufacturing around January 2027, with both lines fully operational by end FY27. Local compressors (2 million units capacity) are expected to cut costs and external supply-chain and FX risk.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the price increase is cost-driven, and is there demand risk?
qa_highlights.answer: Pricing is selective and category-specific, with two rounds taken this year; management first absorbed costs through efficiency and localisation. No major demand slowdown was seen after the increases.

qa_highlights.question: What is export contribution and the impact of geopolitics?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give a Q2 export contribution figure. It expects significant YoY export growth, sees geopolitical uncertainty, and says geographic diversification limits dependence on any single market.

qa_highlights.question: How should B2B be modelled, and is there data-centre exposure?
qa_highlights.answer: B2B is about 10-12% of revenue, with a long-run ambition of 20%+ growth; institutional display is the strongest sub-segment. Data-centre cooling is being watched, with chillers as the product, but management said it is too early to size.

risks_watch: Commodity (steel, aluminium, copper, resin) and currency pressure on margins; memory chip cost pressure in TV.
Channel inventory built ahead of festive season (working capital up INR 6.56 bn); sell-through in Q3 needs to confirm.
Execution risk on Sri City compressor (Q3 FY27) and RAC (around January 2027) start-up timelines.
Vehicle solutions is new; no investment size, revenue target or timeline was disclosed.
Export growth dependence on geopolitics; export contribution not quantified in the call.
Possible demand response to further price increases.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on demand, festive season and capacity timelines, but evasive on quantitative detail: no export share, B2B figures, margin guidance or vehicle solutions economics were given. Management stressed a 'strategic' view of pricing and margins rather than specific targets.
key_quotes: We remain firm on track to commence compressor manufacturing at the facility in the third quarter of this fiscal year, a milestone that will strengthen our cost competitiveness, deepening our localization levels and support the next phase of our growth both domestically and in global markets.
Today, I'm very proud to announce that we are entering the vehicle solution business in India.
Our first approach is not to pass this higher cost directly to consumers.
